facts: An overseas department of France, about 890,000 people (2023)
679 km east of Madagascar, 175 km southwest of Mauritius
worth_knowing: Piton de la Fournaise is one of Earth's most active volcanoes. Piton des Neiges, the island's highest point at 3,070 m, is dormant.
